mapper.update: LOCK TABLE TB_CL_CLOSE, TB_SY_OPER_STD, TB_PJ_ASGN, TB_HR_DEV, TB_BS_CLNT, TB_BS_PART, TB_SY_CODE IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.sql: d.dev_id,d.mng_no,d.dev_nm,d.emp_type_cd,COALESCE(d.blng_clnt_id,'') AS blng_clnt_id,d.grade_cd, d.job_cd,d.sub_job_cd,d.jbps_cd,d.drct_cls_cd,d.part_id,d.jncmp_dt,d.retire_dt,d.home_area_cd,d.home_addr, d.work_stat_cd,d.use_yn,COALESCE(c.clnt_nm,'자사') AS organization_name, COALESCE(e.code_nm,d.emp_type_cd) AS employee_name,g.code_nm AS grade_name, COALESCE(j.code_nm,d.job_cd) AS job_name,r.mon_uprc,r.mon_pay_amt

LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.clnt_id=d.blng_clnt_id LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE e ON e.code_grp_id='EMP_TYPE' AND e.code=d.emp_type_cd LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE g ON g.code_grp_id='GRADE' AND g.code=d.grade_cd LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE j ON j.code_grp_id='JOB' AND j.code=d.job_cd LEFT JOIN TB_HR_DEV_PRC r ON r.dev_id=d.dev_id AND r.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND (r.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR r.aply_end_ym >= #{month})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_HR_DEV d WHERE d.dev_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM TB_HR_DEV d WHERE d.dev_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF d
SELECT code,code_nm FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE code_grp_id=#{groupId} AND use_yn='Y' AND del_yn='N' ORDER BY sort_ord,code
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_BS_CLNT WHERE clnt_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y' AND clnt_type_cd IN ('VNDR','BOTH'))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_BS_PART WHERE part_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y')
SELECT skill_nm FROM TB_HR_DEV_SKILL WHERE dev_id=#{id} ORDER BY sort_ord,skill_nm
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_HR_DEV_PRC SET aply_end_ym=#{previousMonth},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE dev_id=#{developerId} AND aply_bgn_ym < #{month} AND (aply_end_ym IS NULL OR aply_end_ym >= #{month})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_HR_DEV_PRC(dev_id,aply_bgn_ym,aply_end_ym,mon_uprc,mon_pay_amt,reg_user_id) VALUES(#{developerId},#{month},(SELECT to_char(to_date(min(aply_bgn_ym),'YYYYMM')-INTERVAL '1 month','YYYYMM') FROM TB_HR_DEV_PRC WHERE dev_id=#{developerId} AND aply_bgn_ym > #{month}), #{monthlyRate,jdbcType=NUMERIC},#{monthlyPay,jdbcType=NUMERIC},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(dev_id,aply_bgn_ym) DO UPDATE SET mon_uprc=EXCLUDED.mon_uprc,mon_pay_amt=EXCLUDED.mon_pay_amt, mod_user_id=EXCLUDED.reg_user_id,mod_dttm=clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT area_cd,COALESCE(emd_nm,sgg_nm,sido_nm) AS area_name FROM TB_SY_ADM_AREA WHERE use_yn='Y' AND upper_area_cd=#{parentAreaCode}AND upper_area_cd IS NULL ORDER BY area_cd
SELECT area_cd,upper_area_cd,concat_ws(' ',sido_nm,sgg_nm,emd_nm) AS address FROM TB_SY_ADM_AREA WHERE area_cd=#{areaCode} AND use_yn='Y'

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.proj_id,p.proj_nm,COALESCE(j.code_nm,a.job_cd) AS job_name,a.input_bgn_dt,a.input_end_dt,a.ctrt_mm FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.proj_id=a.proj_id LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE j ON j.code_grp_id='JOB' AND j.code=a.job_cd WHERE a.dev_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' ORDER BY a.input_bgn_dt,a.proj_id,a.asgn_id
SELECT dev_id,stat_sn,work_stat_cd,bgn_dt,end_dt,stat_rsn,close_leave_sn,orgnl_leave_end_dt,reg_user_id FROM TB_HR_DEV_STAT WHERE dev_id=#{id} ORDER BY bgn_dt DESC,stat_sn DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_HR_DEV_STAT WHERE dev_id=#{id} AND stat_sn=#{sequence}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_CL_CLOSE WHERE close_ym=#{month} AND close_stat_cd='CLOSE') OR COALESCE(#{month} < (SELECT std_val::bigint::text FROM TB_SY_OPER_STD WHERE std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM' ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1),false)
SELECT reg_dttm,chg_item_nm,bfr_val,aft_val,reg_user_id,chg_rsn FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_HR_DEV' AND trgt_key=#{id} ORDER BY reg_dttm DESC,hist_id DESC
